claim: Generated programs cannot escape their permitted execution environment or access private evaluation state; workloads that require VM-grade isolation are refused where it is unavailable.

measured.vm_grade_isolation: refused: not available on this host (no KVM, no user namespaces)

caveats: Isolation is an unprivileged uid with Landlock and seccomp inside an unprivileged container, not a VM: a host-kernel exploit through a permitted system call would escape it. All sandbox workers share one uid; signalling, resource limits and scheduling calls on other processes are filtered, the shared uid itself remains.
